Every time the sub state COMM_PNC_REQUESTED is entered from other states, ComM shall request COMM_FULL_COMMUNICATION for Specification of Communication Manager AUTOSAR CP R22 - 11 39 of 193 Document ID 79 : AUTOSAR_SWS_COMManager all configured ComM channels which are referenced by this PNC via parameter ComMChannelPerPnc (see [ECUC_ComM_00880] ) and where ComMWakeupSleepRequestEnabled is set to FALSE or not available, even if the channel is already requested.
